read_velocity_log module¶

read_velocity_log.read_velocities(filename)[source]¶

Reads a file where velocities are logged like (with i : iteration, c : cell, x,y : coordinates) v_i_c_x v_i_c_y v_i_c+1_x v_i_c+1_y … v_i+1_c_x v_i+1_c_y

Parameters:filename (string) – name of the file to parse
Returns:velocities_array – Array containing the velocities
Return type:numpy array
